skill_name: Create a product description for a weight loss diet plan.
workflow: This diet plan is a surefire way to lose weight without compromising on the essential nutrients your body needs. This plan provides your body with 3 servings of whole grains, two servings of fruits, three servings of vegetables, two servings of fish and seafood, and two servings of plant-based proteins daily, so you can achieve the proper balance of nutrients while still achieving your weight loss goals. With this diet plan, you won't feel deprived and can actually enjoy the foods you're eating
